diffs.diff: pin count: part has 6 (GND VPU SDA SCL GPOUT CE), datasheet reading has 5 (GND VPU SDA SCL GPOUT)
diffs.evidence: SparkFun Battery Babysitter board file silkscreen on the header edge reads GND (x=7.62), VPU (10.16), SDA (12.7), SCL (15.24), GPOUT (17.78), !CE! (20.32) on both top and bottom layers. Net '!CE!' connects U1 (BQ24075) pad 4 and R8 to JP11 pad 1; net GPOUT connects U2 (BQ27441) pad 12 to JP11 pad 2. JP10 (1x04) carries GND/VPU/SDA/SCL, so the header has 6 pins; the second reading omitted the charger's active-low CE pin.

diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 1.62 V, datasheet reading 3 V
diffs.evidence: TI BQ27441-G1 datasheet, Recommended Operating Conditions: 'VPU External pullup voltage for open-drain pins (SDA, SCL, GPOUT) 1.62 ... 3.6 V'. The modeled supply pin is VPU (the gauge itself runs from BAT, 2.45-4.5 V). The 3 V figure in the second reading is the board's VOUT power-path output range ('between 3V and 5.5V' per SparkFun hookup guide), not the VPU header pin.

TI datasheet standard commands table: 'Temperature() TEMP 0x02 and 0x03 0.1°K' and 'InternalTemperature() 0x1E and 0x1F 0.1°K'. Both readings use scale 0.1; the second reading stays in kelvin (offset 0), while the model converts to degrees Celsius (raw*0.1 - 273.15), which is the same quantity in a different but equivalent unit (driver: _word(_TEMP)/10 - 273.15; sim control unit °C).
